summary.text: Mary Anito is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 34-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as a business operator; in a Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a small business owner and engineer with experience in manufacturing, homeless services and housing.

paragraphs.text: Mary Anito earned a high school diploma from the Albany Academy for Girls, a bachelor's degree from Johns Hopkins University in 2006, and a graduate degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 2012.
Her career experience includes working as a business operator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Anito said she has led teams of hundreds of people and managed substantial budgets in the private and nonprofit sectors, and she described herself as a community leader supporting local schools.
She said her first job was in government consulting, for one year.
Anito's stated first-day priorities were fully funded education, universal healthcare for Washingtonians, and housing and support for everyone.
She also listed manageable cost of living, transportation including ferries, buses and trains, and using data and science to address climate change.
